summary.headline: Indogulf Q2 FY27 revenue rose 3% to INR255.8 crore and EBITDA 27% to INR40.6 crore (16% margin) despite a weak monsoon; operating cash flow was negative in H1.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue from operations was INR255.8 crore, up 3% YoY and up about 52% QoQ from INR168.5 crore, despite weak kharif demand from a below-normal monsoon and drought in parts of the country. Gross margin improved to 30% from 29% and EBITDA margin to 16% from 13%, which management attributed to product mix and cost control. H1 FY27 revenue fell 3% YoY to INR424.3 crore, and inventory rose to INR349.6 crore with working capital stretched, leaving operating cash flow negative. Management expects Q3 FY27 to remain challenging, with industry earnings bottoming between October and December 2026.

segments.name: Channel mix (H1 FY27)
segments.commentary: B2C (brand business) 59%, B2B (technicals/institutional) 35%, exports 6% of revenue.

segments.name: Product mix (H1 FY27)
segments.commentary: Crop protection 85% of revenue; plant nutrients 5%; biologicals 6%; balance other products.

segments.name: Export crop protection mix (Q2 FY27)
segments.commentary: Fungicides 57%, herbicides 28%, insecticides 15%. Egypt grew 129% YoY and was the strongest export market.

segments.name: Key brands (H1 FY27 vs H1 FY26)
segments.commentary: Indo Apache INR11.50 crore (from INR10.77 crore); Fire INR9.73 crore (from INR7.74 crore, +31%); Spine INR5 crore (from INR2.84 crore, +76%); Nova King INR2.23 crore (from INR9 lakh).

segments.name: Abhiprakash Globus (subsidiary)
segments.commentary: Revenue of INR33.35 crore in the quarter, up 58% QoQ; entered Chhattisgarh and Orissa; operating in 7-8 states.

guidance_outlook: Q3 FY27 expected to remain challenging; industry analysts expect agri-input earnings to bottom between October and December 2026, with recovery from Q1 FY28 if weather normalises.
Management expects operating cash flow to turn positive in H2 FY27, driven by debtor collections and inventory liquidation.
IMD expects El Nino to persist through winter, with easing around February 2027; Rabi soil moisture and channel inventory liquidation are the key H2 monitorables.
Management declined to give forward-looking margin or revenue guidance for FY27 or FY28, citing regulatory and commitment constraints.
Climate-stress/PGR facility at Barwasni (Sonipat, 9,000 sq ft) expected operational by Q4 FY27; results expected to add to top and bottom line in the coming year.
capex_capacity: Board proposed reallocating INR8.34 crore of unutilised IPO proceeds from an in-house DF plant to specialty machinery and a dedicated climate-stress/plant growth regulator facility at Barwasni, Sonipat (9,000 sq ft); pending AGM approval.
DF line cited as facing pricing pressure and shrinking margins; flagship climate-stress technology is phosphorus derived from rhodophytes.
Capacity utilisation averaged 60% in H1 FY27 (70% in Q1, around 50% in Q2) as production is aligned to demand.
Field trials initiated for Empire and Indo Apache in Brazil via a Brazilian CRO agreement.
demand_pricing: Industry: monsoon about 13% below long-period average, the weakest since 2015; drought declared in parts of Southern India and Maharashtra; dealers cautious on restocking and industry channel inventory built up ahead of season.
Generic agrochemical prices rose roughly 15-20% between March and May 2026 due to Middle East conflict, then corrected to pre-conflict levels from June, limiting pass-through of costs.
Export disruption from container shipping availability, higher freight rates and geopolitics; management said export situation is 'a little discount' and is prioritising domestic B2C.

New export markets: Taiwan entry; Israel entry for plant nutrition; Sudan sales reactivated; repeat order of 44 MT in Venezuela after 95 MT NutriX export; Sri Lanka import permission and positive field trials for Indo Apache; Thailand registration for Spiromesifen 24% SC.
New specialty products: Shaan sold about INR4.5 crore and Polgar about INR4.25 crore in six months; management cited about INR11-12 crore across three specialty products and is hopeful for H2.
Green series nutrient basket grew around 40% in H1 FY27.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the gross margin improvement is mix versus input cost or pricing?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed gross margin improvement to a richer product mix, with higher contribution from nutrients and biologicals, despite higher purchase-side cost pressure.

qa_highlights.question: Why was operating cash flow negative despite positive EBITDA in H1?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO cited higher debtors due to low rainfall, inventory build-up from below-plan sales and purchase-led fund outflows; management expects positive operating cash flow in H2 FY27.

qa_highlights.question: What are the key growth priorities for the next 3-5 years?
qa_highlights.answer: Biologicals and nutrients as the main drivers, plus Abhiprakash Globus expansion and domestic B2C brand business across both entities.

qa_highlights.question: Which export geography is most concentrated?
qa_highlights.answer: Middle East and Africa are the current core; expansion under way in Latin America (Venezuela, Brazil trials), and Asia (Taiwan, Thailand, Sri Lanka). Export sales below expectations due to shipping and geopolitical disruption.

qa_highlights.question: What is the target for B2B growth and margin outlook for FY27 and FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: No B2B target given; management stated B2C brand business is the focus, and declined to provide forward-looking margin or revenue commitments.

qa_highlights.question: How are the three specialty products contributing?
qa_highlights.answer: Shaan about INR4.5 crore and Polgar about INR4.25 crore in six months; combined about INR11-12 crore including a third product; H2 expected to be supportive.

risks_watch: Negative H1 operating cash flow and working capital stretch: inventory INR349.6 crore and rising debtors; H2 cash flow turn-positive is a key test.
Q3 FY27 expected to be challenging; El Nino persistence through winter and Rabi soil moisture uncertainty.
Channel inventory liquidation and dealer restocking pace; generic price correction since June may limit pricing power.
Export weakness from shipping availability, freight and geopolitical disruption; Q2 export share only 6% of H1 revenue.
Shareholder approval and execution of the INR8.34 crore capex reallocation to climate-stress facility by Q4 FY27.
Low utilisation (around 50% in Q2) and sustainability of the 16% Q2 EBITDA margin; management gave no forward margin guidance.
Auditable CFO/CEO remarks on trade payables increase during the call were general; no quantified supplier-terms disclosure.
summary.management_tone: Cautious and measured on the near term: management described Q3 as challenging and declined forward margin or revenue commitments, while emphasising margin and cost discipline and product mix. Confidence is expressed on specialty products, biologicals and export registrations, but answers on cash flow and export shortfalls were brief and qualitative.
key_quotes: Despite the difficult backdrop, we delivered growth with improved profitability.
We, therefore, expect Q3 FY '27 to remain a challenging quarter.
We are more closely working on the debt collections.
We are expecting in the second half, we will be in the positive position.
